name: ee.kristiineautorent/car-rental
title: Kristiine Autorent
description: Car rental in Tallinn, Estonia: check availability, compare prices and book a car.

tools.name: list_rental_locations
tools.description: List the pickup and return locations Kristiine Autorent operates from in Tallinn, Estonia, with the numeric ids that search_available_cars requires. Call this first to translate a place name (for example "Tallinn airport") into a location id. Besides the office, the list normally includes Tallinn Airport, the passenger port and delivery to the renter's own address near the office; a delivery location has no address of its own, so the renter's address goes into the "additional" note when the booking is submitted.

tools.name: search_available_cars
tools.description: Search cars available for a rental period and return the total price of each. Dates are wall-clock time in Tallinn (Europe/Tallinn), format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, and minutes must be 00 or 30. Location ids come from list_rental_locations. Each car reports contactlessAvailable: whether it can be picked up and returned without meeting staff, so its handover does not depend on the office being open. Pass contactlessOnly to get just those cars. This fills in the booking form on the page, shows the results to the user, and clears any previously selected car and extras.

rentDateTime.description: Pickup date and time in Tallinn local time, e.g. 2026-08-15T10:00

returnDateTime.description: Return date and time in Tallinn local time, e.g. 2026-08-18T10:00

gearboxType.description: Optional gearbox filter. Omit to see both.

contactlessOnly.description: Optional. True returns only cars with contactlessAvailable: true. The page itself keeps showing every available car.

couponCodes.description: Optional discount codes to apply to the quote

tools.name: select_car
tools.description: Pick one of the cars returned by search_available_cars, move the user to the extras step, and return the insurance and accessory options for that car. Run search_available_cars first.

carId.description: The id of a car from search_available_cars

tools.name: list_extra_services
tools.description: List the insurance packages and accessories available for the selected car and rental period, with their prices and whether each one is currently selected. Requires a car to be selected first.

tools.name: set_selected_services
tools.description: Replace the whole set of selected extras with the given service ids, so pass every id that should end up selected and omit the rest. At most one INSURANCE service may be included. Ids come from list_extra_services or select_car.

serviceIds.description: The complete set of service ids to select. Pass an empty array to clear all extras.

tools.name: get_booking_summary
tools.description: Read back everything currently selected on the page: rental period, locations, car, extras, coupons and the full price breakdown including the deposit. Use this to confirm the booking with the user before submitting it.

tools.name: submit_booking_new_customer
tools.description: Place the booking for the currently selected car, period and extras, registering the renter as a new customer. This creates a real, binding rental booking and sends a confirmation email, so only call it once the user has reviewed get_booking_summary and explicitly confirmed all of the personal details and the rental terms. If the renter has booked here before, use submit_booking_returning_customer instead.

email.description: Renter email address, used as the customer identity

phone.description: Phone number including country code, e.g. +372 5555 1234

address.description: Street address including city and country

idCode.description: National identity code of the renter

acceptsTerms.description: Must be true. The user has to have accepted the rental terms.

acceptsDataHandling.description: Must be true. The user has to have accepted the data handling policy.

additional.description: Free-text note for the rental company. When the pickup or return location is delivery to the renter's own address, put that street address here.

drivesAbroad.description: Whether the car will be driven outside Estonia

estimatedMileage.description: Estimated kilometres over the rental period

wantsContactless.description: Whether the renter wants contactless issuance: picking the car up and returning it without meeting staff. The contract is signed and paid online before pickup, and the renter unlocks the car from their phone. Only possible when the selected car has contactlessAvailable: true.

acceptsMarketing.description: Whether the user opted in to marketing emails

tools.name: submit_booking_returning_customer
tools.description: Place the booking for the currently selected car, period and extras using only the email address of a customer who has rented here before. This creates a real, binding rental booking and sends a confirmation email, so only call it once the user has reviewed get_booking_summary and explicitly confirmed. Fails if no customer with that email exists, in which case use submit_booking_new_customer.

email.description: Email address of the existing customer

additional.description: Free-text note for the rental company. When the pickup or return location is delivery to the renter's own address, put that street address here.

drivesAbroad.description: Whether the car will be driven outside Estonia

estimatedMileage.description: Estimated kilometres over the rental period

wantsContactless.description: Whether the renter wants contactless issuance: picking the car up and returning it without meeting staff. The contract is signed and paid online before pickup, and the renter unlocks the car from their phone. Only possible when the selected car has contactlessAvailable: true.
